candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old. The child has fever, and the temperature measured is 38.0°C. The fever has been there for 2 days. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. The child does not have a generalized rash. Malaria risk in the area is high. Malaria test is available, and the result is negative. There is no obvious cause of fever identified. No bacterial cause has been identified in this assessment. The child has not had measles within the last 3 months, and there is no cough linked to measles. The child does not have red eyes, runny nose, or stiff neck. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing, does not have diarrhoea, and does not have any ear problem.
